text:
Priya (CSM): Heads up — BlueHarbor dropped ~70% API calls over the last 10 days. Renewal in ~6 weeks, exec sponsor changed last month. They also opened a trial with CerebroAI last week. Concerned this could move to a competitive switch. :warning:

Jasper (AM): Ugh. Do we have a root cause? Any onboarding or infra regressions?

Priya (CSM): No infra alerts. Support ticket #4321 shows a spike in 429s around 3/9 but resolved. Usage change looks customer-driven — fewer query types and fewer active users.

Lee (SE): I can pull model/route-level metrics. Quick check: can someone run this in analytics?
```
SELECT route, count(*) as calls, avg(latency_ms)
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id = 'blueharbor'
AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY calls desc;
```

Maya (CS Manager): Priya, do we know which stakeholder left? Who's the new sponsor?

Priya (CSM): Primary sponsor (CTO Erin Park) left 3 weeks ago. New point is Head of Data, Tom Alvarez — hasn't committed to the platform yet. Tom attended the kickoff but asked to evaluate cheaper options.

Ken (Sales Ops): Can we offer a short cost/throughput analysis vs CerebroAI? We should give them a clear unit-cost comparison and a targeted perf benchmark.

Jasper (AM): Agree. Also propose a 4-week Dedicated trial or a tailored batch-caching config to reduce their per-token spend. If they see cost parity + stability, may stick.

Lee (SE): I'll prepare a perf runbook and offer a joint session with Tom. Need a short list of representative queries from BlueHarbor — Priya can you ask for 3 example workloads?

Priya (CSM): On it. I'll ask for examples and stakeholder availability this afternoon.

dev-support-bot: Support ticket #4321 — full logs attached. No downstream errors after 3/9 fix. :white_check_mark:

Maya (CS Manager): Action items: 1) Priya — get 3 sample queries & confirm Tom's availability. 2) Lee — perf plan + quick cost comparison vs CerebroAI. 3) Jasper/Ken — prepare an offer (trial/discount) we can propose in renewal window. 4) Ops — verify no quota/ACL changes on our side. Update by EOD tomorrow. :calendar: :mag_right:

Jasper (AM): If BlueHarbor signals competitive PoC, let's lock a check-in with Sales + Solutions Eng before they talk further with Cerebro. Priya, flag me once you have Tom's slot and I'll join. :handshake:
